controls.answer:
According to the documentation: If ensure_ascii is true (the default), the output is guaranteed to have all incoming non-ASCII and non-printable characters escaped.

Source excerpt: allow_nan_false_valueerror: True; ensure_ascii_default_true: True; ensure_ascii_escapes_non_ascii: True; jsondecodeerror_invalid_document: True; loads_bytes_bytearray: True; read_text_signature: encoding=None, errors=None, newline=None; sort_keys_sorts_dicts: True
By default ensure_ascii is on: every character outside ASCII is written as a \uXXXX escape sequence instead of the raw character.
ensure_ascii defaults to False, so non-ASCII characters are written to the output as they are.
The default of ensure_ascii is true, and setting it changes the indentation of the output.
